title: Vita Coco Company, Inc. 8-K Filing — Departure of Director
summary: Vita Coco Company, Inc. (ticker COCO, listed on NASDAQ) filed an 8-K on April 10, 2026 announcing that board member John Leahy will retire from the Board of Directors at the 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders on June 3, 2026. Leahy cited personal reasons for the departure with no disagreement with company operations. The board will shrink from 10 to 9 members following his retirement.
key_points: John Leahy, board member since 2019, will retire effective June 3, 2026 at the Annual Meeting
Leahy served on the Audit Committee and Compensation Committee
Retirement due to personal reasons only; no disagreement with company operations, policies, or practices
Board of Directors will decrease from 10 to 9 members post-retirement
Filing signed by CEO Martin Roper on April 10, 2026
